app.name: Tribe
app.title: Tribe dashboard
app.description: A private reel strategist for one person.

palette.title: Find
palette.description: Jump to a page or a reel.

runner.label: Runner
runner.help: Jobs wait in the queue while the laptop runner is off.

footer.text: Built on {tribe} by Meta FAIR, licensed {licence} (non-commercial). {llama}. Free, not affiliated with Meta. Shows a predicted average-brain response, not a view forecast.

shape.suggestedHint: Suggested by Claude, not accepted yet
shape.measuredHint: Measured from the caption or post data

copyCommand.failed: Copy failed: select the text instead
copyCommand.label: Run on the laptop

jobs.fixturesMode: Fixtures mode: nothing was queued. Jobs run only with TRIBE_DATA_SOURCE=db.
jobs.queued: Queued. The runner picks it up next.
jobs.queuedOffline: Queued. It waits until the runner is online.
jobs.failed: The queue did not answer. Try again.
jobs.confirmed: Confirmed. The runner checks the limits again before it starts.
jobs.notWaiting: That job is no longer waiting.

confirm.title: Run this paid job?
confirm.limits: The runner checks the caps and daily limits first, and refuses if its own estimate comes out higher.

errors.refused: This page failed its contract check, so it is not shown.

board.tribeTable: TRIBE read, yes or no for each reel
board.tribeHint: Whether a deep read exists. Its lines are on the reel page.
board.footnote: Counts are scraped snapshots, not live.

creators.title: Creators
creators.body: Each creator's own reels: the median, the window and what was left out.

empty.title: No reels yet
empty.hint: Run it on the laptop. It prints the Apify estimate first and runs only with --yes after a go. Then push the pages: python -m strategist.sync push

counts.title: Counts
counts.chartLabel: Dot plot of plays on a log scale: the creator's own reels as small dots, the own median as a dashed line and this reel as a filled dot.
counts.footnote: Plays on a log scale. Counts are scraped snapshots, not live.

discount.title: Discount these counts
discount.body: Why are these counts not a fair picture? Nothing is discounted automatically.
discount.placeholder: a partner tag in the caption

private.title: Private details stay on this laptop
private.body: Transcript, stills and quotes never leave the laptop. Open the full page there.

labels.title: Shape labels
labels.hint: Claude suggests, you accept or reject. Outlined means suggested, filled means accepted.
labels.rebuild: After accepting or rejecting labels, rebuild the patterns.

beats.title: Beats
beats.groupHint: Beats are accepted or rejected together from here. One beat at a time works on the laptop.

facts.title: Facts
facts.hint: Worked out on the laptop from word times and the video.
facts.wall: Public counts (plays, likes, comments) and the predicted average-brain response are separate layers: they never share a line, a sort or a chart.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.label: Beats and predicted response lanes over time. Use the arrow keys to move the selected second.
timeline.labelNoBrain: Beats over time. Use the arrow keys to move the selected second.
timeline.noMoments: No HIGH or FLAT moments in this read.

empty.body: Opt-in: one picked reel at a time, about ${usd} each, at most {n} a month. Never compared across reels.

missing.body: The read from {date} is on the laptop. Push the cleaned pages to show it here.

peak.title: Brain at HIGH {time}
peak.alt: Map of the predicted average-brain response at {time}

brain.title: Predicted average-brain response
brain.canvasLabel: 3D map of the predicted average-brain response at {time}, left and right sides, on one colour scale for this whole reel. Drag to turn it.
brain.noWebgl: This browser cannot draw the 3D brain map.

legend.label: Colour scale
legend.scale: one colour scale for this whole reel
legend.about: Each surface point is coloured by the predicted average-brain response at the selected second. Points near 0 stay grey; colour is full from halfway up the scale.

hover.noLine: not part of the four lines

credit.atlas: Areas: HCP-MMP1 (Glasser et al., 2016) and Yeo-7 networks (Yeo et al., 2011).
credit.hcp: Data were provided in part by the Human Connectome Project, WU-Minn Consortium (Principal Investigators: David Van Essen and Kamil Ugurbil; 1U54MH091657) funded by the 16 NIH Institutes and Centers that support the NIH Blueprint for Neuroscience Research; and by the McDonnell Center for Systems Neuroscience at Washington University.

areas.title: Areas
areas.label: Areas over time
areas.hint: The predicted average-brain response averaged over each atlas area, second by second, on one scale for this whole reel. Rows stay in atlas order (Yeo network, then HCP area) and never move.
areas.marks: A warm or cool mark: the area is coloured on the brain at the selected second.
areas.atlasNames: Atlas names mark places on the cortex, not feelings or functions.

download.label: Download
download.hint: Values are stored at 255 levels on this reel's one colour scale, so each surface point is close to the model output, not exact. One reel only.
download.failed: The file could not be built.

csv.footer: Predicted average-brain response from TRIBE v2 (Meta FAIR, CC BY-NC 4.0). Built with Llama. Non-commercial use only. Not a view forecast.
csv.units: TRIBE v2 model output averaged over each area's vertices; relative only
csv.surfaceUnits: TRIBE v2 model output per surface point, stored at 255 levels on this reel's one colour scale; relative only
csv.oneReel: one reel only: never put two reels' numbers side by side
csv.atlasNames: atlas names mark places on the cortex, not feelings or functions
csv.derived: derived data shared only under the HCP Open Access terms
csv.yeo: Yeo BT, Krienen FM, Sepulcre J, Sabuncu MR, Lashkari D, Hollinshead M, Roffman JL, Smoller JW, Zollei L., Polimeni JR, Fischl B, Liu H, Buckner RL. The organization of the human cerebral cortex estimated by intrinsic functional connectivity. Journal of Neurophysiology 106(3):1125-1165, 2011. doi:10.1152/jn.00338.2011

patterns.about: Shapes and public post data only. Deep reads are never used here.

legend.outliersDef: Reels at 2x or more the creator's own median plays.
legend.normalDef: The same creators' other reels in the same pull.

lead.title: Seen more in outliers
lead.note: A share of outliers at least 10 points above the share of normal reels. A shape to test in a draft, never proof that it works.

index.startNowBody: The /script skill or this command starts a draft on the laptop.

draft.label: Script
draft.sharedRun: Shared 6-word run. The words and their source stay on the laptop.

variants.title: Hook variants
variants.unordered: Unordered: each is a different shape to test, in no order.

brain.title: No brain read on drafts
brain.body: The hook pair test is not built yet: two voice memo takes of the opening, read on one scale.
brain.note: It would show the predicted average-brain response to each take: an average brain, not an audience, and never a pick between the takes.

checks.title: Checks
checks.private: Only where a run sits is shown here. The words and their source stay on the laptop.
checks.none: Nothing to fix or look at.

length.title: Length
length.bar: Beats over about {est} s, target {target} s

refine.thisButBody: Keeps every other line as it is.
refine.replaceBody: Swaps one phrase for another wherever it sits.
refine.command: Paste into Claude Code on the laptop

laptop.body: Full details are on the laptop: the private page shows the shared runs, their sources and the PROOF file. It never leaves the laptop.

hints.variants: About the order of the variants

export.title: Export
export.note: Made {date} from the hosted pages. Counts, shape tags, patterns and brain output sit under separate keys. Brain numbers are one reel each, in fixed atlas order, never compared across reels.
export.licence: TRIBE v2, CC BY-NC 4.0, Meta FAIR
export.hint: One file: the board's counts and shape tags, the patterns, and the predicted average-brain response per second for each reel with a read. Counts and brain numbers sit under separate keys. No words, captions, stills or video.

import.title: Import
import.intro: Paste reel links. See the shape of the results.
import.placeholder: Paste reel links here, one per line
import.noLinks: No reel links found. Paste links like instagram.com/reel/CODE.
import.banner: Demo output: made-up numbers. No job runs, nothing is fetched and nothing is spent.
import.brainNote: One scale for this reel only, in fixed network order. An average brain, not your audience.
import.hint: A preview of how real results will look. The numbers are made up from the link, so the same link always shows the same demo. Counts, shape and brain output stay in separate boxes and are never compared across reels.

runner.title: Runner
runner.setupBody: Jobs run on the laptop. Keep the runner on.
runner.fixtures: Fixtures mode: no runner, synthetic rows.

spend.apifyCap: Stops at ${cap} of the $5.00 free credit.

pause.label: Pause queue
pause.body: Queued jobs wait. A running job finishes.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyBody: Jobs queued from other pages show here.
